title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. australis
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. australis, commonly known as Kidney vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that aid in wound healing and the treatment of gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Kidney vetch include stimulating blood circulation, reducing fever, and acting as a mild laxative. The bioactive constituents of Kidney vetch include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
